title: Oozy Glassy Filipino Beef Bistek
description: A low-sodium Filipino dish featuring saffron and leaf-wrap-steam, resulting in a jammy and glassy-jelly texture, perfect for meal prep.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beef sirloin, saffron threads, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, black pepper, and salt, and mix well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight to marinate.
Prepare the banana leaves by cutting them into 4 equal pieces and washing them with water.
Remove the beef from the marinade and wrap each piece in a banana leaf, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the wrapped beef in a steamer basket and steam for 10 minutes or until the beef is cooked through.
Remove the beef from the steamer and let it cool to room temperature.
Once cooled, slice the beef into thin strips and serve with the remaining sauce from the marinade.
